gameDescriptionHtml:
Someone Made a Mess. You Have to Clean It Up

You wake up in your slightly outdated video game store. You don’t know why you fell asleep, but you do know that while you were sleeping, your coworker – Jeff the cat – knocked all the cases off the shelves. Your task is simple – you must put all 4,290 game cases back in their proper places (according to genre and order) – only then will you be able to finish your shift.

Organize, Progress, Speed Up
Organizing 4,290 cases is only the beginning. As you progress, you will develop your character through an extensive skill tree. Unlockable abilities will make managing the mess easier and help you reach your ultimate goal faster.

The progression is incremental: you start as an ordinary employee surrounded by cases, but over time, you become a true master of store logistics.

Powerful Boosts That Let You Clean and Organize More Efficiently
There are plenty of them, ranging from increased movement speed all the way to automatically picking up an entire game series. In Game Keeper, a sense of progression is absolutely fundamental.

A Paradise for Fans of Video Game References
The cases reference existing classics through their names and visual styles, either paying homage to them or making fun of them. Pop culture fans will find plenty to smile about here.

eet Your Co-worker
Jeff is a cat. Jeff has a gambling problem. Jeff has no intention of doing anything about it.

Thanks to him, you will gain access to a gambling machine, where you can take a risk and win all kinds of upgrades. Maybe you’ll get exactly what you need. Maybe you’ll simply enable a cat to make even more terrible financial decisions.

Key Features

  • 4,290 game cases waiting to be put in their proper places
  • 650 game series
  • 96 racks to fill
  • Hundreds of references to popular games and series
  • Satisfying gameplay centered around organizing
  • An extensive skill tree
  • Incremental character progression and increasingly powerful upgrades
  • Abilities that make organizing the enormous collection more efficient
  • A gambling-based reward system run by the coolest cat in the galaxy – Jeff
  • A huge store, an even bigger mess, and one absurdly ambitious goal
  • Realistic graphics and lighting
  • Hidden collectibles that grant special boosts
  • A great atmosphere and music that will immerse you in the role of a video game store employee
  • An achievement and challenge system

If you enjoy cleaning up virtual spaces, watching numbers grow, unlocking upgrades, and spotting video game references, you’ll feel right at home here. And if you like cats, too…
